title: Edward Wotton (Scotland) to Walsingham, drafts of 25 Aug, 30 Aug and 1 Sep 1585 (DECODE R4841-R4843)

steps.what: Fetched the twelve DECODE images of R4841-R4843 with the stored cookie.
Recognised the pages as Wotton's own clear-English drafts headed 'To Mr Secretary', with code numbers only for names; no letter cipher.
Identified the code numbers from context: 19 Arran, 39 Master of Gray, 10 King James (certain); 9 Elizabeth/England, 20 Maxwell, 24 Huntly, 3 France (probable).
Tried to check CSP Scotland vol. 8 for the calendared despatches and their resolved names; BHO paywalled, archive.org copy lending-only.

outcome.notes: Drafts read in full; 7 of 11 code numbers identified (3 certain, 4 probable), 27, 32, 36, 40 open.

prior.where: CSP Scotland vol. 8 (1914) calendars Wotton's despatches of these dates; not consulted (BHO paywalled, archive.org lending-only). DECODE lists the records as Non-decrypted.

human: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE account cookie.
